changes_only: Outcome-blind reuse certification for unaffected REV1 artifacts
unchanged: QCRD quality features, masks, losses and fixed weights
R1 and conditional R2 seed sets and frontier policy
No labels in training, construction, preflight or reuse audit

symbols.z1_z2: Authoritative paired private views in identical ordered spot rows.
symbols.zf_raw: Authoritative frozen family reference embedding before dimension harmonization.
symbols.d_view: Feature dimension shared by z1 and z2.
symbols.zf_aligned: Frozen reference embedding in d_view dimensions used by QCRD forward, fusion and boundary loss.

identity_case.operation: Return zf_raw exactly. Do not run SVD, copy, cast or renormalize.
identity_case.required_evidence: Canonical array SHA before and after is identical.

rectangular_expansion_case.aligned: zf_aligned=row_l2_normalize(X@P), cast once to float32 after all audits
constraints: rank(C)=d_ref under rtol=1e-10 relative to max singular value
max_abs((X@X.T)-(X@P)@(X@P).T)<=1e-10 on a deterministic audited row subset and <=1e-8 for full summary
Repeat computation in the locked environment has identical canonical P SHA

dimension_contract.unsupported_case: If d_ref>d_view, d_ref<=0, dimensions are non-finite, or the rank/orthogonality/determinism gates fail, stop as IMPLEMENTATION_SEMANTICS_INVALID. No truncation, zero padding, random projection or trainable projection is authorized.

use_of_aligned_reference.adapter_input: concat(student_input[d_view], stopgrad(teacher[d_view]), stopgrad(zf_aligned[d_view]), optional fixed coordinates)
use_of_aligned_reference.boundary_loss_reference: Use zf_aligned. Rectangular orthogonality preserves the reference sample geometry within the registered tolerance.
use_of_aligned_reference.reference_partition: The authoritative historical reference partition remains unchanged and is never recomputed from zf_aligned for Q00 reporting.
use_of_aligned_reference.gradient: P and zf_aligned are frozen and have no gradient.
use_of_aligned_reference.routing: The implementation must not accept or inspect a dataset name when selecting identity versus expansion.

per_row_actions: Load the actual registered views, graph, coordinates where applicable, frozen partitions and reference embedding
Assert the full schema and all authoritative hashes
Construct or reuse the frozen harmonizer
Run the actual candidate forward and every registered loss component
Run backward, gradient finite checks and exactly one temporary optimizer step
Perform checkpoint state round-trip and inference output shape/finite checks
real_runtime_preflight.synthetic_substitution: Forbidden. Synthetic unit tests remain useful but cannot satisfy any of the 210 real rows.
real_runtime_preflight.formal_link: Every formal config must contain a preflight row SHA that binds unit, input hashes, harmonizer hash, candidate, code commit and contract SHA.
real_runtime_preflight.pass_gate: 210/210 real rows must pass before any formal training. Any missing row is a failure, not not-applicable.

rev1_artifact_reuse.grouping: All 21 R1 cells of a dataset are reused together or retrained together. Per-cell outcome-based reuse is forbidden.
required_checks: All declared REV1 artifacts match their preserved SHA and no source file changed
Identity harmonizer path is canonical-array-SHA exact
All checkpoints load with exact state SHA
All 21 cells per dataset replay corrected-view arrays within max_abs<=1e-7 and with identical shapes and finite status
Existing fixed-endpoint partitions and manifests match authoritative hashes
No labels or metric tables are read during the reuse decision
rev1_artifact_reuse.existing_transforms: The 42 completed A1 and tonsil transforms may be reused only after the checks above. Missing D1 transforms must be computed from the locked reused corrected views.
rev1_artifact_reuse.p22_rule: All 21 P22 R1 cells are newly trained under REV2 after preflight passes because REV1 failed before the first optimizer step.
rev1_artifact_reuse.failure_rule: If a dataset group fails reuse certification, do not mix reused and retrained cells within that dataset. Retrain the full 21-cell group before labels are opened, or stop if the task budget does not authorize it.

labels.evaluation: Only after all R1 formal outputs, including recovered and new outputs, are locked and pushed.
